engine: r1864's /collection — a vertical STACK of TIER bands, each announcing a product tier with a giant serif TITLE + a small body + a STAT-ROW (big serif numerals + small labels: высота / спальни / площадь / терраса) + a framed CTA + a DUAL-IMAGE split (interior + city-view). As each tier enters it ANNOUNCES (title -> body -> stat-row -> the two images stagger in) AND the page GROUND theme TWEENS to that tier's palette (dark-green -> taupe -> cream). The 'browse the collection by tier' chapter. Harvested from D_r1864 (r18643: ИСТОРИЧЕСКАЯ КОЛЛЕКЦИЯ -> ЧАСТНАЯ -> С ТЕРРАСАМИ -> ВИЛЛА -> ПЕНТХАУСЫ).

measured_teardown.move: PER TIER (scroll-into-view, p 0..1, PURE setTier(i,p)): title fade + translateY 30->0 over 0..0.4; body 0.15..0.5; each stat fade + translateY 24->0 staggered over 0.30..0.7; cta fade 0.40..0.7; the two images each clip-reveal (inset bottom 100%->0) + scale 1.06->1, staggered, over 0.45..1.0. ease power3.out. THEME-SHIFT: a SEPARATE ScrollTrigger per tier tweens the stage css-vars (--cta-bg/ink/dim/line) to that tier's data-theme palette when it crosses centre (a short power2.inOut tween) — so the ground colour travels dark-green -> taupe -> cream across tiers. The theme tween is NOT scrubbed over media.
measured_teardown.cited: r18643 /collection: each tier = giant serif title top-left + framed 'ВЫБРАТЬ АПАРТАМЕНТЫ' CTA top-right + a small body in the left margin + a stat-row (e.g. ИСТОРИЧЕСКАЯ: 3,4-4 высота сводов / 1-2 спальни / 105-165 площадь) + a dual-image split (interior + heritage exterior / city-view). Grounds: ИСТОРИЧЕСКАЯ dark-green, ЧАСТНАЯ/С ТЕРРАСАМИ/ВИЛЛА taupe ladder, ПЕНТХАУСЫ cream.

start.what: ScrollTrigger start for each tier's announce.

themeStart.what: start for the per-tier theme-shift trigger.

clipFrom.what: edge the dual images clip from: bottom | top | left | right.

once.what: announce once per tier or reset on leave-back.

manageLenis.what: own a Lenis instance if present; false when a shared page Lenis drives scroll.

entry: CollectionTierAnnounce.create(target, opts) -> { triggers, lenis, setTier(i,p), play(), setTheme(theme), refresh(), destroy }. target = .cta-stage > .cta-tier[data-theme] x N, each = .cta-head( .cta-title + .cta-cta ) + .cta-body + .cta-stats( .cta-stat[ .cta-num + .cta-lab ] ) + .cta-split( .cta-img x2 ). data-theme = JSON {bg,ink,dim,line}. setTier(i, p 0..1) is a PURE scrub of tier i's announce.
law: clip-path(inset) + transform + opacity + a SHORT css-var theme tween (power2.inOut, NOT scrubbed, NOT over media) only; GPU; NO mix-blend; NO WebGL. reduced-motion or <=820px -> shown (each tier static at its own theme, grid collapses to 1 col). owns_pin false (a stack of scroll-into-view announces). GSAP+ScrollTrigger required for the scroll; setTier(i,p) standalone. Theme is per-tier data-theme JSON; the stage reads --cta-bg/ink/dim/line.
gate_mode: a stack of scroll-into-view tier announces + a ground theme-shift. Verify: each tier announces (title -> body -> stat-row -> dual-image clip-reveal stagger) on enter; the stage ground travels dark-green -> taupe -> cream as you scroll through the tiers. Smoothness via the scroll path. NOTE: tall multi-tier section — to screenshot a tier, scroll so that tier fills the frame; the theme is per-tier so the ground colour differs top vs bottom.
proven: lab: 5 tiers (ИСТОРИЧЕСКАЯ green -> ЧАСТНАЯ -> С ТЕРРАСАМИ -> ВИЛЛА taupe ladder -> ПЕНТХАУСЫ cream), each with title + body + stat-row (real r1864 numerals: 3,4-4/1-2/105-165 ... 3,4-7,5/5-7/623-987/558-664) + framed CTA + dual-image split. TIER-1 announce curve measured live (p / title / body / stat / cta / img-clip-inset-bottom): 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 0 / 100% -> 0.30 / 0.98 / 0.81 / 0 / 0 / 100% -> 0.50 / 1 / 1 / 0.88 / 0.70 / 70.2% -> 0.75 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 3.7% -> 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 1 / 0%. THEME-SHIFT: stage bg tier1 rgb(39,48,42) dark-green -> tier5 rgb(231,224,210) cream (shifted=true). Zero console errors. Smoothness probe (4x CPU throttle, scroll through all 5 tiers): 576 frames, 0.52% long frames -> PASS. NO mix-blend (perf law).
